scope: Read-only timing decomposition of 40 existing API-verified practice HTTP sessions of frozen 760af823. Historical baseline only, not an optimized-version HTTP benchmark or organizer-verified final result.

timing_contract.timestamps: requests.jsonl recorded_at timestamps in UTC from the same local client wall clock; no monotonic per-request timer is available.
timing_contract.request_to_response: Difference from local request log to matching serial response log; includes HTTP/client serialization, local logging/scheduling and network/service wait. Cannot separately identify pure network and server execution.
timing_contract.response_to_state: Difference from response log to client-state log; local response processing/state update/logging wall time.
timing_contract.state_to_next_request: Difference from preceding client-state log to next request log; includes policy computation, client preparation, logging and OS scheduling. Not process CPU or pure algorithm time.
timing_contract.program_wall: summary.program_wall_time_s; local runner endpoint measurement, including small overhead outside search.run.
timing_contract.search_program_runtime: summary.search.program_runtime_s; full local search.run wall duration including synchronous HTTP waits.
timing_contract.validation: Every session contains matched serial request/response/state triplets, no logged retry/error event; nonnegative deltas and decomposition sum equal first-request-to-last-state span within 1e-8 s.
timing_contract.percentile: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p across per-run aggregate durations.
timing_contract.privacy: Only relative paths, content hashes, strategy identity, timestamps and numeric aggregates retained; no robot_id, casecode, payload, request/response body or requests raw text.

interpretation: Historical request-to-response waiting accounts for about half the recorded baseline span on these sessions.
30.7% offline wall-time reduction must not be reported as 30.7% real simulator end-to-end reduction; waiting and client effects may remain or fluctuate.
No optimized-version official/practice HTTP session was run or inferred by this analysis.
These 40 distinct historical sessions are not paired against the offline benchmark cases or machines; do not derive an observed end-to-end gain from unmatched data.
